'''Mike Gray''' was a Decipherian. [[Yerka Mig]] is an anagram of his name.<ref name="anagrams">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians], Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (geocities.ws/plarathas). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012174750/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Internet Archive]. Mirrors: [https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html oocities.org] (Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008200413/https://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive]); reocities (Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160406045459/http://www.reocities.com/CollegePark/plaza/9433/anagrams.html Internet Archive])</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], Players Committee, p. 200. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The rules booklet of the [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] thanks Mike Gray and [[Carol Wisely]] "for turning a million instructions into fewer rules".<ref name="2p-credits">[https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Introductory Two-Player Game Rules Booklet], Decipher / Parker Brothers (1995), credits page. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015192404/https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Internet Archive]</ref> Decipher made that game with Parker Brothers, which distributed it,<ref name="2p-credits" /> so he may be the Parker Brothers and Hasbro game designer Michael Gray; that identification is possible but unconfirmed.
